records.literal_gloss: You have planned shame for your house, cutting off peoples many, and sinning [against] your soul.

en.L: You have planned shame for your house, \q cutting off many peoples, and sinning [against] your soul.
en.B: Your schemes have brought shame on your house; \q by cutting off many peoples you have forfeited your own life.
en.R: Your plans have brought shame to your family. \q You destroyed many nations, and so you have lost your own life.

es.L: Has tramado vergüenza para tu casa, \q exterminando a muchos pueblos, y pecando [contra] tu alma.
es.B: Tus planes han traído vergüenza a tu casa; \q al exterminar a muchos pueblos has perdido tu propia vida.
es.R: Tus planes han cubierto de vergüenza a tu familia. \q Destruiste muchas naciones, y así has perdido tu propia vida.

fr.L: Tu as projeté la honte pour ta maison, \q en supprimant beaucoup de peuples, et tu as péché [contre] ton âme.
fr.B: Tes projets ont attiré la honte sur ta maison ; \q en supprimant de nombreux peuples, tu as perdu ta propre vie.
fr.R: Tes plans ont couvert ta famille de honte. \q Tu as détruit beaucoup de nations, et c’est ainsi que tu as perdu ta propre vie.

sw.L: Umeipangia nyumba yako aibu, \q kwa kukatilia mbali watu wengi, na kutenda dhambi [juu ya] nafsi yako.
sw.B: Mipango yako imeleta aibu juu ya nyumba yako; \q kwa kuwakatilia mbali watu wengi umepoteza maisha yako mwenyewe.
sw.R: Mipango yako imeiletea jamaa yako aibu. \q Uliangamiza mataifa mengi, na hivyo umepoteza maisha yako mwenyewe.

vi.L: Ngươi đã mưu tính sự nhục nhã cho nhà ngươi, \q diệt trừ nhiều dân tộc, và phạm tội [nghịch cùng] linh hồn ngươi.
vi.B: Mưu kế của ngươi đã đem sự nhục nhã đến cho nhà ngươi; \q khi diệt trừ nhiều dân tộc, ngươi đã tự đánh mất mạng sống mình.
vi.R: Những kế hoạch của ngươi đã làm cho gia đình ngươi bị nhục nhã. \q Ngươi đã tiêu diệt nhiều dân tộc, và vì thế ngươi đã mất chính mạng sống mình.

ko.L: 네가 네 집을 위하여 수치를 꾀하였다. \q 많은 백성을 끊어 버리고 네 영혼에 [대하여] 죄를 지었다.
ko.B: 네 계략이 네 집안에 수치를 가져왔다. \q 많은 백성을 멸절시키다가 네 목숨을 잃게 되었다.
ko.R: 네 계획이 네 집안을 부끄럽게 만들었다. \q 너는 많은 민족을 멸망시켰고, 그래서 네 목숨을 잃게 되었다.

decisions.choice: sinning against your soul: forfeiting your own life
decisions.reason: To sin against one's soul is to bring about one's own death (Proverbs 8:36; 20:2). The one who cut off many peoples has, by that very act, condemned himself.

decisions.choice: You have planned shame for your house: the opposite of what he intended
decisions.reason: He planned glory for his house and has planned, without meaning to, its shame. The irony is the point of the saying.

decisions.choice: forfeited your own life (B); lost your own life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1).

source.text: כִּי־אֶ֖בֶן מִקִּ֣יר תִּזְעָ֑ק וְכָפִ֖יס מֵעֵ֥ץ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For a stone from [the] wall will cry out, and a rafter from [the] woodwork will answer it.

en.L: For [the] stone will cry out from [the] wall, \q and [the] rafter from [the] woodwork will answer it.
en.B: The very stones will cry out from the wall, \q and a beam from the woodwork will answer them.
en.R: The stones in the walls of your house will shout out against you, \q and the wooden beams will answer them.

es.L: Porque la piedra clamará desde el muro, \q y la viga del maderamen le responderá.
es.B: Las mismas piedras clamarán desde el muro, \q y una viga del maderamen les responderá.
es.R: Las piedras de las paredes de tu casa gritarán contra ti, \q y las vigas de madera les responderán.

fr.L: Car la pierre crie depuis le mur, \q et la poutre de la charpente lui répond.
fr.B: Les pierres mêmes crient depuis le mur, \q et une poutre de la charpente leur répond.
fr.R: Les pierres des murs de ta maison vont crier contre toi, \q et les poutres en bois leur répondront.

sw.L: Kwa maana jiwe litalia kutoka ukutani, \q na boriti ya kwenye mbao italijibu.
sw.B: Mawe yenyewe yatalia kutoka ukutani, \q na boriti ya kwenye mbao itayajibu.
sw.R: Mawe katika kuta za nyumba yako yatapiga kelele dhidi yako, \q na boriti za mbao zitayajibu.

vi.L: Vì đá sẽ kêu la từ trong tường, \q và rui mè từ khung gỗ sẽ đáp lại nó.
vi.B: Chính đá trong tường sẽ kêu lên, \q và thanh xà trong khung gỗ sẽ đáp lời.
vi.R: Đá trong tường nhà ngươi sẽ kêu lên tố cáo ngươi, \q và các cây xà gỗ sẽ đáp lời chúng.

ko.L: 이는 [그] 돌이 벽에서 부르짖고, \q 나무 [구조물]에서 서까래가 그것에 대답할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 벽에서 돌들이 부르짖고, \q 나무 구조물에서 들보가 그것들에 대답할 것이다.
ko.R: 네 집 벽의 돌들이 너를 고발하며 소리칠 것이고, \q 나무 들보들이 그 소리에 대답할 것이다.

decisions.choice: the stone will cry out from the wall: the house itself bears witness
decisions.reason: The house built by violence testifies against its builder, as Abel's blood cried out from the ground (Genesis 4:10). Stone and wood call to each other like witnesses in court.

decisions.choice: rafter: a beam of the woodwork
decisions.reason: The word is used only here; it is a beam or rafter, or perhaps a piece of the paneling.

decisions.choice: against you
decisions.reason: Readable says that the stones cry out against the builder (m1).

source.text: ה֛וֹי בֹּנֶ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּדָמִ֑ים וְכוֹנֵ֥ן קִרְיָ֖ה בְּעַוְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to one who] builds a city with blood, and establishes a town with injustice!

en.L: Woe, [the one who] builds a city with bloodshed \q and establishes a town with injustice!
en.B: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed \q and founds a town with wrongdoing!
en.R: How terrible it will be for the one who builds a city by killing people \q and builds a town by doing wrong!

es.L: ¡Ay del que edifica una ciudad con sangre \q y establece una población con injusticia!
es.B: ¡Ay del que edifica una ciudad con derramamiento de sangre \q y funda una población sobre la iniquidad!
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para el que construye una ciudad matando gente \q y levanta un pueblo haciendo el mal!

fr.L: Malheur, [celui qui] bâtit une ville avec le sang \q et fonde une cité par l’injustice !
fr.B: Malheur à celui qui bâtit une ville dans le sang \q et fonde une cité sur l’injustice !
fr.R: Quel malheur pour celui qui bâtit une ville en tuant des gens \q et construit une cité en faisant le mal !

sw.L: Ole, [yeye] ajengaye mji kwa damu \q na kuusimamisha mji kwa udhalimu!
sw.B: Ole wake ajengaye mji kwa umwagaji damu \q na kuusimika mji kwa uovu!
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa yule anayejenga mji kwa kuua watu \q na kujenga mji kwa kutenda maovu!

vi.L: Khốn cho [kẻ] xây thành bằng máu \q và lập thị trấn bằng sự bất công!
vi.B: Khốn cho kẻ xây dựng thành bằng máu \q và lập thị trấn bằng điều gian ác!
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho kẻ xây thành bằng cách giết người \q và dựng thị trấn bằng những việc làm sai trái!

ko.L: 피로 성을 세우고 \q 불의로 성읍을 굳게 세우는 자에게 화가 있다!
ko.B: 피를 흘려 성을 쌓고 \q 불의로 성읍을 세우는 자에게 화가 있다!
ko.R: 사람을 죽여서 도시를 세우고 \q 악한 일을 해서 성읍을 세우는 자에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다!

decisions.choice: builds a city with bloodshed: the words of Micah 3:10
decisions.reason: Micah accuses Jerusalem's leaders of building "Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustice". Habakkuk uses the same words of Babylon, whose great building works were paid for by plunder and the forced labor of conquered peoples (Jeremiah 22:13 says the same of a king of Judah).

decisions.choice: the Micah 3:10 wording; Woe (L), Woe to (B), How terrible it will be for (R)
decisions.reason: The words shared with Micah 3:10 follow the published wording there at Literal and Balanced. The cry "Woe" follows verse 6.

decisions.choice: "bằng máu … bằng sự bất công" (L), "bằng máu … bằng điều gian ác" (B), "giết người … những việc làm sai trái" (R), the published Micah 3:10 words at each level
decisions.reason: Habakkuk uses Micah's words of Babylon (m1); the shared words follow Micah 3:10.

source.text: הֲל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְיִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּדֵי־אֵ֔שׁ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים בְּדֵי־רִ֥יק יִעָֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Is it not, look, from Yahweh of hosts, that peoples toil for [the] sufficiency of fire, and nations for [the] sufficiency of nothing grow weary?

en.L: Is it not, look, from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts \q that peoples toil only for fire, \q and nations weary themselves for nothing?
en.B: Has not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies decreed \q that the peoples toil only for the fire \q and the nations wear themselves out for nothing?
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has decided \q that everything the nations work so hard to build will only be burned. \q They wear themselves out for nothing.

es.L: ¿No es, he aquí, de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos \q que los pueblos trabajen solo para el fuego, \q y las naciones se cansen para nada?
es.B: ¿No ha decretado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos \q que los pueblos se fatiguen solo para el fuego \q y las naciones se agoten para nada?
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha decidido \q que todo lo que las naciones construyen con tanto esfuerzo terminará quemado. \q Se agotan para nada.

fr.L: N’est-ce pas, voici, de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées \q que des peuples se fatiguent seulement pour le feu, \q et que des nations s’épuisent pour le néant ?
fr.B: N’est-ce pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées qui a décidé \q que les peuples se fatiguent seulement pour le feu \q et que les nations s’épuisent pour rien ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a décidé \q que tout ce que les nations ont construit avec tant de peine finira brûlé. \q Elles se sont épuisées pour rien.

sw.L: Je, si, tazama, kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi \q kwamba watu wanajitaabisha kwa ajili ya moto tu, \q na mataifa wanajichosha bure?
sw.B: Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi hakuamua \q kwamba watu wajitaabishe kwa ajili ya moto tu, \q na mataifa wajichoshe bure?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameamua \q kwamba kila kitu ambacho mataifa yanajitaabisha kujenga kitaungua tu. \q Wanajichosha bure.

vi.L: Này, chẳng phải bởi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân \q mà các dân lao khổ chỉ cho lửa, \q và các nước nhọc nhằn cho điều hư không sao?
vi.B: Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã định \q rằng các dân lao nhọc chỉ để cho lửa thiêu \q và các nước kiệt sức cách vô ích sao?
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã quyết định \q rằng mọi thứ các dân tộc ra sức xây dựng sẽ chỉ bị thiêu rụi. \q Họ kiệt sức cách vô ích.

ko.L: 보라, 민족들이 불을 위하여 수고하고 \q 나라들이 헛된 것을 위하여 지치는 것이 \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게서 [나온 것이] 아니냐?
ko.B: 민족들의 수고가 불에 탈 것뿐이고 \q 나라들이 헛되이 지치게 되는 것은 \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 정한 일이 아니냐?
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 정하였다. \q 민족들이 그토록 애써 지은 것이 모두 불타 버릴 것이다. \q 그들은 헛되이 지칠 뿐이다.

decisions.choice: peoples toil for fire, nations for nothing: the words of Jeremiah 51:58
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 51:58 uses the same words of Babylon's walls: "peoples toil for nothing, and nations for fire". What the conquered nations were forced to build for Babylon will be burned; their labor was in vain. Habakkuk sets the two halves in the other order.

decisions.choice: from the LORD of hosts: it is God who decrees Babylon's end
decisions.reason: The woe of verse 12 is not only the nations' taunt: the LORD himself has decided that the empire built by violence will come to nothing.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (L); the LORD of Armies (B, R); only for fire, for nothing
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the title. "For the sufficiency of fire" means only to feed the fire; the words follow Jeremiah 51:58 at Balanced ("only for the fire", "wear themselves out").

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L), "de los Ejércitos" (B, R); "trabajen … para el fuego", "se cansen" (L), "se fatiguen … se agoten" (B), the published Jeremiah 51:58 words
decisions.reason: The settled title, and the words Habakkuk shares with Jeremiah 51:58 (m1).

decisions.choice: "se fatiguent … pour le feu", "s'épuisent pour le néant / pour rien", the published Jeremiah 51:58 words; "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level
alternatives: "le SEIGNEUR des Armées" at B and R, as the English "of Armies"
decisions.reason: The line repeats Jeremiah 51:58, so French reuses the published Jeremiah's verbs where the Hebrew is the same. French keeps "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level, as the term sheet, where the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies".

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi"; "wanajitaabisha … kwa ajili ya moto tu", "wanajichosha bure", the published Jeremiah 51:58 words
decisions.reason: The settled title, and the words shared with Jeremiah 51:58 (m1).

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân", span on CHÚA only; "lao khổ … cho lửa", "nhọc nhằn cho điều hư không" (L), "lao nhọc … kiệt sức" (B), the published Jeremiah 51:58 words
decisions.reason: The settled title, and the words shared with Jeremiah 51:58 (m1).

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B); "하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R), without -시- because the oracle is God's word; "불을 위하여 수고하고 … 지치는" as Jeremiah 51:58
decisions.reason: The settled title; the woes are also the LORD's own word (m2), and God does not honor himself with -시-.

source.text: כִּ֚י תִּמָּלֵ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה כַּמַּ֖יִם יְכַסּ֥וּ עַל־יָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For will be filled the earth to know the glory of Yahweh, as the waters cover over [the] sea.

en.L: For the earth will be filled with knowing the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q as the waters cover over the sea.
en.B: For the earth will be as full of knowing the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q as the sea is full of water.
en.R: Everyone on earth will know the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q The earth will be full of this knowledge, just as the oceans are full of water.

es.L: Porque la tierra se llenará del conocimiento de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q como las aguas cubren el mar.
es.B: Porque la tierra estará tan llena del conocimiento de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q como el mar está lleno de agua.
es.R: Todos en la tierra conocerán la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q La tierra estará llena de este conocimiento, así como los océanos están llenos de agua.

fr.L: Car la terre sera remplie de la connaissance de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q comme les eaux couvrent la mer.
fr.B: Car la terre sera aussi pleine de la connaissance de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} \q que la mer est pleine d’eau.
fr.R: Tout le monde sur la terre connaîtra la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q La terre sera remplie de cette connaissance, comme les océans sont remplis d’eau.

sw.L: Kwa maana dunia itajaa kuujua utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama maji yanavyoifunika bahari.
sw.B: Kwa maana dunia itajaa kuujua utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kama bahari ilivyojaa maji.
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani ataujua utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Dunia itajaa maarifa haya, kama bahari zilivyojaa maji.

vi.L: Vì đất sẽ đầy dẫy sự hiểu biết vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q như nước phủ lấp biển.
vi.B: Vì sự hiểu biết vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ tràn ngập đất \q như nước tràn đầy biển cả.
vi.R: Mọi người trên đất sẽ biết vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Đất sẽ đầy dẫy sự hiểu biết ấy, như đại dương đầy dẫy nước.

ko.L: 물이 바다를 덮음같이 \q 땅이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광을 아는 지식으로 가득할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 바다가 물로 가득하듯이 \q 땅이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광을 아는 지식으로 가득할 것이다.
ko.R: 세상 모든 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광을 알게 될 것이다. \q 바다가 물로 가득하듯이 온 땅이 그 영광을 아는 지식으로 가득할 것이다.

decisions.choice: the earth filled with the knowledge of the LORD: the words of Isaiah 11:9
decisions.reason: Isaiah 11:9 says: "the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea". Habakkuk adds "the glory of" and says "will be filled". Set among the woes, the line says that Babylon's empire will vanish, but the knowledge of the LORD's glory will cover the earth. Numbers 14:21 and Psalm 72:19 speak of the earth filled with his glory.

decisions.choice: knowing the glory of the LORD: recognizing his greatness and presence
decisions.reason: The glory (*kavod*) of the LORD is his weight, majesty and visible presence. "To know" it is to recognize and acknowledge it, not only to know facts about it.

decisions.choice: the Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level, with "the glory of" added
decisions.reason: Each level reuses the published wording of Isaiah 11:9 ("as the waters cover the sea" at Literal, "as the sea is full of water" at Balanced, "just as the oceans are full of water" at Readable), adding "the glory of" as Habakkuk does. Literal says "filled with knowing", since the Hebrew uses the verb "to know" where Isaiah has the noun, and "cover over" for Habakkuk's "over the sea".

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level, with "de la gloria" added; "se llenará" (L) for Habakkuk's "will be filled"
decisions.reason: Habakkuk reuses Isaiah 11:9 (m1); Spanish keeps Isaiah's words and adds only what Habakkuk adds.

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level, with "de la gloire" added
decisions.reason: Habakkuk repeats Isaiah 11:9 and adds "the glory of"; French keeps Isaiah's sentence at each level and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level ("dunia itajaa kumjua BWANA"), with "kuujua utukufu wa" for Habakkuk's "the glory of"
decisions.reason: Habakkuk reuses Isaiah 11:9 (m1); the Swahili of Isaiah already uses the verb "to know", as Habakkuk's Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level, with "vinh quang của" added
decisions.reason: Habakkuk reuses Isaiah 11:9 (m1); only Habakkuk's addition changes the words.

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 11:9 wording at each level ("물이 바다를 덮음같이" L; "바다가 물로 가득하듯이" B, R), with "영광을" added
decisions.reason: Habakkuk reuses Isaiah 11:9 (m1); only Habakkuk's addition changes the words.

source.text: ה֚וֹי מַשְׁקֵ֣ה רֵעֵ֔הוּ מְסַפֵּ֥חַ חֲמָתְךָ֖ וְאַ֣ף שַׁכֵּ֑ר לְמַ֥עַן הַבִּ֖יט עַל־מְעוֹרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to one who] makes drink his neighbor, mixing in your wrath, and even making [them] drunk, in order to look on their nakedness!

en.L: Woe, [the one who] makes his neighbor drink, \q mixing in your wrath and making [them] drunk, \q in order to look on their nakedness!
en.B: Woe to him who makes his neighbors drink, \q pouring out his fury until they are drunk, \q so that he can gaze at their nakedness!
en.R: How terrible it will be for the one who makes his neighbors drunk, \q pouring out wine mixed with his anger, \q so that he can look at their naked bodies!

es.L: ¡Ay del que hace beber a su prójimo, \q [del que] mezcla tu furor y aun [lo] embriaga, \q para mirar su desnudez!
es.B: ¡Ay del que hace beber a sus vecinos, \q derramando su furor hasta embriagarlos, \q para contemplar su desnudez!
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para el que emborracha a sus vecinos, \q dándoles vino mezclado con su enojo, \q para poder mirar sus cuerpos desnudos!

fr.L: Malheur, [celui qui] fait boire son prochain, \q en y mêlant ta fureur, et même [l’]enivre, \q afin de regarder leur nudité !
fr.B: Malheur à celui qui fait boire ses voisins, \q en déversant sa fureur jusqu’à les enivrer, \q pour contempler leur nudité !
fr.R: Quel malheur pour celui qui fait boire ses voisins jusqu’à les rendre ivres, \q en leur versant du vin mêlé de sa colère, \q pour pouvoir regarder leur corps nu !

sw.L: Ole, [yeye] amnyweshaye jirani yake, \q akichanganya ghadhabu yako, na hata kumlewesha, \q ili kutazama uchi wao!
sw.B: Ole wake awanyweshaye jirani zake, \q akimimina ghadhabu yake hata wakalewa, \q ili apate kutazama uchi wao!
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa yule anayewalewesha jirani zake, \q akiwamiminia divai iliyochanganywa na hasira yake, \q ili aitazame miili yao ilivyo uchi!

vi.L: Khốn cho [kẻ] cho người lân cận mình uống, \q pha trộn cơn giận của ngươi, và còn làm cho [họ] say, \q để nhìn sự trần truồng của họ!
vi.B: Khốn cho kẻ bắt láng giềng mình uống, \q rót cơn thịnh nộ mình cho đến khi họ say, \q để nhìn ngắm sự trần truồng của họ!
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho kẻ chuốc rượu cho láng giềng mình say, \q rót cho họ rượu pha với cơn giận của nó, \q để nhìn thân thể trần truồng của họ!

ko.L: 자기 이웃에게 마시게 하며 \q 네 분노를 섞어 [그들을] 취하게 하여 \q 그들의 벌거벗은 몸을 보려는 자에게 화가 있다!
ko.B: 이웃들에게 술을 먹이며 \q 그들이 취하도록 자기 분노를 쏟아붓고 \q 그들의 알몸을 바라보려는 자에게 화가 있다!
ko.R: 이웃들을 취하게 하려고 \q 자기 분노를 섞은 포도주를 부어 주며 \q 그들의 벌거벗은 몸을 보려는 자에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다!

decisions.choice: makes his neighbor drink ... to look on their nakedness: the shaming of the nations
decisions.reason: The picture is of a host who gets his guests drunk to see them shamefully exposed (compare Genesis 9:21-22). It stands for the way Babylon made the nations drink its wine (Jeremiah 51:7) and stripped them of honor and goods. The next verse turns the cup on Babylon.

decisions.choice: mixing in your wrath
decisions.reason: The word translated "wrath" also means "poison" or "venom" (Deuteronomy 32:24, 33), and the verb may mean "pouring out" or "mixing in". The line may be "mixing in your poison": a drugged drink. "Your" is a sudden shift to speaking to him.

decisions.choice: Woe (L), Woe to (B), How terrible it will be for (R); his neighbors, his fury (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cry follows verse 6. Balanced and Readable say "his" for "your" so that the verse speaks about him throughout; the Hebrew shifts to "your" (m2). "Neighbor" stands for the neighboring nations, so they say "neighbors".

decisions.choice: "tu furor" (L), keeping the Hebrew's sudden "your"; "su furor" (B), "su enojo" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shifts to speaking to him (m2); Balanced and Readable say "his", as the English does.

source.text: שָׂבַ֤עְתָּ קָלוֹן֙ מִכָּב֔וֹד שְׁתֵ֥ה גַם־אַ֖תָּה וְהֵֽעָרֵ֑ל תִּסּ֣וֹב עָלֶ֗יךָ כּ֚וֹס יְמִ֣ין יְהוָ֔ה וְקִיקָל֖וֹן עַל־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You are sated [with] shame more than glory. Drink, also you, and be exposed as uncircumcised! It will come round to you, the cup of [the] right hand of Yahweh, and utter disgrace [will be] on your glory.

en.L: You are sated with shame instead of glory; \q drink, you too, and be exposed as uncircumcised! \q The cup of the right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will come around to you, \q and utter disgrace [will be] on your glory.
en.B: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. \q Drink, you too, and be exposed as uncircumcised! \q The cup in the right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will come around to you, \q and disgrace will cover your glory.
en.R: You will be covered with shame instead of honor. \q Now it is your turn to drink and be shown naked and disgraced! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} holds a cup of punishment in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand, and it will be passed to you. \q Your glory will turn into shame.

es.L: Te has saciado de vergüenza más que de gloria; \q ¡bebe tú también, y muéstrate incircunciso! \q La copa de la diestra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vendrá a ti, \q y la ignominia [estará] sobre tu gloria.
es.B: Te llenarás de vergüenza en lugar de gloria. \q ¡Bebe tú también, y quede a la vista que eres incircunciso! \q La copa que está en la mano derecha {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llegará hasta ti, \q y la ignominia cubrirá tu gloria.
es.R: Te cubrirás de vergüenza en vez de honra. \q ¡Ahora te toca a ti beber y quedar desnudo y avergonzado! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha una copa de castigo, y te la pasarán a ti. \q Tu gloria se convertirá en vergüenza.

fr.L: Tu es rassasié de honte plutôt que de gloire ; \q bois, toi aussi, et montre-toi incirconcis ! \q La coupe de la main droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} viendra jusqu’à toi, \q et l’infamie [sera] sur ta gloire.
fr.B: Tu seras rassasié de honte au lieu de gloire. \q Bois, toi aussi, et montre que tu es incirconcis ! \q La coupe que tient la main droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} passera jusqu’à toi, \q et l’infamie couvrira ta gloire.
fr.R: Tu seras couvert de honte au lieu d’honneur. \q Maintenant c’est ton tour de boire et d’être exposé tout nu, couvert de honte ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite une coupe de punition, et elle va passer jusqu’à toi. \q Ta gloire va se changer en honte.

sw.L: Umeshiba aibu badala ya utukufu; \q kunywa, wewe pia, na uonekane hujatahiriwa! \q Kikombe cha mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kitakuzungukia, \q na aibu kuu [itakuwa] juu ya utukufu wako.
sw.B: Utashiba aibu badala ya utukufu. \q Kunywa, wewe pia, na ionekane kwamba hujatahiriwa! \q Kikombe kilicho katika mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kitakufikia, \q na aibu itaufunika utukufu wako.
sw.R: Utafunikwa na aibu badala ya heshima. \q Sasa ni zamu yako kunywa na kuonyeshwa uchi na kuaibishwa! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameshika katika mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume kikombe cha adhabu, nacho kitapitishwa kwako. \q Utukufu wako utageuka kuwa aibu.

vi.L: Ngươi no nê sự nhục nhã thay vì vinh quang; \q ngươi cũng hãy uống đi, và hãy phơi bày [mình là kẻ] không cắt bì! \q Chén của tay phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xoay đến ngươi, \q và sự ô nhục lớn [sẽ ở] trên vinh quang ngươi.
vi.B: Ngươi sẽ đầy dẫy sự nhục nhã thay vì vinh quang. \q Ngươi cũng hãy uống đi, và để lộ mình là kẻ không cắt bì! \q Chén trong tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được chuyền đến ngươi, \q và sự ô nhục sẽ phủ lấp vinh quang ngươi.
vi.R: Ngươi sẽ bị nhục nhã thay vì được tôn trọng. \q Bây giờ đến lượt ngươi phải uống, rồi bị lột trần và bị sỉ nhục! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cầm chén hình phạt trong tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và chén ấy sẽ được chuyền đến ngươi. \q Vinh quang của ngươi sẽ biến thành sự nhục nhã.

ko.L: 네가 영광 대신 수치로 배불렀다. \q 너도 마시고 할례 받지 않은 것을 드러내라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손의 잔이 너에게로 돌아올 것이니, \q 큰 수치가 네 영광 위에 [덮일 것이다].
ko.B: 네가 영광 대신 수치로 가득할 것이다. \q 너도 마시고 할례 받지 않은 몸을 드러내라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손에 들린 잔이 너에게 돌아올 것이니, \q 수치가 네 영광을 덮을 것이다.
ko.R: 네가 영예 대신 수치를 뒤집어쓸 것이다. \q 이제 네가 마시고 벌거벗겨져 창피를 당할 차례다! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오른손에 벌의 잔을 들고 계시니, 그 잔이 너에게 넘어갈 것이다. \q 네 영광이 수치로 바뀔 것이다.

decisions.choice: be exposed as uncircumcised
alternatives: drink, you too, and stagger (Qumran commentary, Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb means "show your foreskin", that is, be stripped naked and shown to be uncircumcised, a deep shame in Israel's eyes. The commentary on Habakkuk among the Dead Sea Scrolls and the Greek translation read a verb with two letters reversed, "stagger", which fits the picture of drunkenness. The translation keeps the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the cup of the LORD's right hand: God's judgment, passed round to Babylon
decisions.reason: The prophets picture judgment as a cup of wine that God gives the nations to drink until they stagger (Jeremiah 25:15-29; Psalm 75:9; Isaiah 51:17). It "comes round" like the cup passed from guest to guest at a feast: Babylon made others drink, and now its turn has come (Jeremiah 25:26).

decisions.choice: utter disgrace
decisions.reason: The word is used only here. It seems to be a strengthened form of the word for "shame" in the first line; some see in it the word for vomit, "shameful vomit", fitting the drunken scene.

decisions.choice: You will be filled (B, R); be shown naked and disgraced (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is in the past tense, as often in prophecy, where a coming event is described as done; Balanced and Readable say "will". Readable says what being exposed as uncircumcised means (m1) and explains the cup (m2).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 … 들고 계시니" (R) with -시-
decisions.reason: Korean honorifics follow the English deity spans; where the English Readable marks God ("his right hand"), the saying speaks of him with -시-, as the nations' taunt about the LORD.

source.text: כִּ֣י חֲמַ֤ס לְבָנוֹן֙ יְכַסֶּ֔ךָּ וְשֹׁ֥ד בְּהֵמ֖וֹת יְחִיתַ֑ן מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For [the] violence of Lebanon will cover you, and [the] destruction of beasts [that] terrified them, because of [the] blood of humankind and [the] violence of [the] land, [the] town and all [who] dwell in it.

en.L: For [the] violence [done to] Lebanon will cover you, \q and [the] destruction of [the] beasts [that] terrified them, \q because of [the] blood of humankind and violence [done to the] land, \q [to the] city and all who live in it.
en.B: The violence you did to Lebanon will overwhelm you, \q and so will the slaughter that terrified its animals, \q because of the human blood you shed and the violence against the land, \q against the city and all who live in it.
en.R: You cut down the forests of Lebanon and killed its animals. Now that violence will come back on you. \q The slaughter of the animals that terrified them will bury you. \q You killed many people. You were violent to the land, \q to the city and to everyone who lives there.

es.L: Porque la violencia [hecha al] Líbano te cubrirá, \q y la destrucción de [las] bestias [que] las aterró, \q a causa de la sangre humana y de la violencia [hecha a la] tierra, \q [a la] ciudad y a todos los que habitan en ella.
es.B: La violencia que hiciste al Líbano te abrumará, \q y también la matanza que aterró a sus animales, \q por la sangre humana que derramaste y la violencia contra la tierra, \q contra la ciudad y todos los que viven en ella.
es.R: Talaste los bosques del Líbano y mataste sus animales. Ahora esa violencia caerá sobre ti. \q La matanza de los animales que los aterrorizó te sepultará. \q Mataste a mucha gente. Fuiste violento con la tierra, \q con la ciudad y con todos los que viven en ella.

fr.L: Car la violence [faite au] Liban te couvrira, \q et la destruction des bêtes [qui] les terrifiait, \q à cause du sang des humains et de la violence [faite au] pays, \q [à la] ville et à tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.B: La violence que tu as faite au Liban t’accablera, \q ainsi que le massacre qui a terrifié ses bêtes, \q à cause du sang humain que tu as versé et de la violence faite au pays, \q à la ville et à tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.R: Tu as abattu les forêts du Liban et tué ses animaux. Maintenant cette violence va retomber sur toi. \q Le massacre des animaux qui les a terrifiés va t’écraser. \q Tu as tué beaucoup de gens. Tu as été violent envers le pays, \q envers la ville et envers tous ceux qui y vivent.

sw.L: Kwa maana ukatili [uliofanywa kwa] Lebanoni utakufunika, \q na maangamizi ya wanyama [ambayo] yaliwatisha, \q kwa sababu ya damu ya wanadamu na ukatili [uliofanywa kwa] nchi, \q [kwa] mji na wote wakaao ndani yake.
sw.B: Ukatili uliofanya kwa Lebanoni utakulemea, \q vivyo hivyo machinjo yaliyowatisha wanyama wake, \q kwa sababu ya damu ya watu uliyoimwaga na ukatili dhidi ya nchi, \q dhidi ya mji na wote wanaoishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Ulikata misitu ya Lebanoni na kuua wanyama wake. Sasa ukatili huo utakurudia. \q Machinjo ya wanyama yaliyowatisha yatakuzika. \q Uliwaua watu wengi. Uliitendea nchi ukatili, \q pamoja na mji na kila mtu anayeishi humo.

vi.L: Vì bạo lực [đã gây ra cho] Li-ban sẽ phủ lấp ngươi, \q và sự tàn sát các thú vật [đã] làm chúng kinh hãi, \q vì máu loài người và bạo lực [đã gây ra cho] đất, \q [cho] thành và mọi người cư ngụ trong đó.
vi.B: Bạo lực ngươi đã gây ra cho Li-ban sẽ đè bẹp ngươi, \q cũng như cuộc tàn sát đã làm thú vật ở đó kinh hãi, \q vì máu người ngươi đã đổ và bạo lực ngươi gây ra cho đất, \q cho thành và mọi người sống trong đó.
vi.R: Ngươi đã đốn hạ rừng Li-ban và giết hại thú vật ở đó. Giờ đây bạo lực ấy sẽ đổ lại trên ngươi. \q Cuộc tàn sát thú vật từng làm chúng kinh hãi sẽ vùi lấp ngươi. \q Ngươi đã giết nhiều người. Ngươi đã đối xử tàn bạo với đất, \q với thành và với mọi người sống ở đó.

ko.L: 레바논에 [행한] 폭력이 너를 덮고, \q 짐승들을 놀라게 한 파멸이 [너를 덮을 것이다]. \q 이는 사람의 피와 땅에 [행한] 폭력, \q 성읍과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 [행한 폭력] 때문이다.
ko.B: 네가 레바논에 행한 폭력이 너를 뒤덮고, \q 그곳 짐승들을 겁에 질리게 한 살육이 너를 덮칠 것이다. \q 네가 사람의 피를 흘리고 땅에 폭력을 행했으며, \q 성읍과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 폭력을 행했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너는 레바논의 숲을 베어 내고 그곳 짐승들을 죽였다. 이제 그 폭력이 너에게 되돌아올 것이다. \q 짐승들을 겁에 질리게 한 그 살육이 너를 덮어 버릴 것이다. \q 너는 많은 사람을 죽였고, 땅에 폭력을 휘둘렀으며, \q 성읍과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 폭력을 휘둘렀다.

decisions.choice: the violence done to Lebanon: the stripping of its forests
alternatives: Lebanon stands for Israel or the temple
decisions.reason: Conquerors felled the cedars of Lebanon for their buildings and hunted its animals (Isaiah 14:8; 37:24). The Babylonian kings, like the Assyrians before them, took timber from Lebanon. Some take Lebanon here as a picture of Israel or the temple, built of its cedar (Jeremiah 22:6, 23).

decisions.choice: the destruction of the beasts that terrified them
alternatives: the destruction of the beasts will terrify you (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "terrified them", most likely the destruction that terrified the animals. The Greek translation and others read "will terrify you", which matches "will cover you" in the first line. The translation keeps the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the second half repeats verse 8
decisions.reason: The line "because of human blood and violence to the land, to the city and all who live in it" closes the first woe in verse 8 and is repeated here. See the note there on its meaning.

decisions.choice: the verse 8 wording repeated at each level; violence you did to Lebanon (B); You cut down the forests (R)
decisions.reason: The repeated line keeps the wording of verse 8. Balanced says whose the violence was; Readable says what it was (m1).

decisions.choice: The last two lines repeat verse 8 word for word at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line (m3).

decisions.choice: The last two lines repeat verse 8 word for word at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line (m3).

decisions.choice: The last two lines repeat verse 8 word for word at each level; "Li-ban"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line (m3).

decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line (m3).

source.text: מָֽה־הוֹעִ֣יל פֶּ֗סֶל כִּ֤י פְסָלוֹ֙ יֹֽצְר֔וֹ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וּמ֣וֹרֶה שָּׁ֑קֶר כִּ֣י בָטַ֞ח יֹצֵ֤ר יִצְרוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֱלִילִ֥ים אִלְּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: What does profit a carved image, that has carved it its maker, a cast image, and a teacher of falsehood? For trusts [the] maker of its form in it, to make idols mute.

en.L: What does a carved image profit, that its maker has carved it, \q a cast image and a teacher of lies? \q For the one who formed it trusts in his own creation \q when he makes mute idols.
en.B: What use is an idol once its maker has carved it, \q or a metal image, a teacher of lies? \q Its maker trusts in what he himself has shaped \q when he fashions idols that cannot speak.
en.R: What good is an idol that someone has carved, \q or a metal statue? It teaches only lies. \q People who make idols trust in what they have made, \q but their idols cannot even talk.

es.L: ¿De qué sirve la imagen tallada, para que su hacedor la tallara, \q la imagen fundida y maestra de mentira? \q Porque el que la formó confía en su propia obra \q cuando hace ídolos mudos.
es.B: ¿De qué sirve un ídolo una vez que su artesano lo ha tallado, \q o una imagen de metal, maestra de mentiras? \q Su hacedor confía en lo que él mismo ha formado \q cuando fabrica ídolos que no pueden hablar.
es.R: ¿De qué sirve un ídolo que alguien ha tallado, \q o una estatua de metal? Solo enseña mentiras. \q Los que hacen ídolos confían en lo que han hecho, \q pero sus ídolos ni siquiera pueden hablar.

fr.L: À quoi sert une image taillée, que son fabricant l’ait taillée, \q une image fondue et un maître de mensonge ? \q Car celui qui l’a formée se confie en sa propre œuvre \q quand il fait des idoles muettes.
fr.B: À quoi sert une idole, une fois que l’artisan l’a sculptée, \q ou une statue de métal, un maître de mensonge ? \q Celui qui l’a façonnée met sa confiance dans ce qu’il a fait lui-même \q quand il fabrique des idoles qui ne parlent pas.
fr.R: À quoi sert une idole que quelqu’un a sculptée, \q ou une statue de métal ? Elle n’enseigne que des mensonges. \q Ceux qui fabriquent des idoles ont confiance dans ce qu’ils ont fait, \q mais leurs idoles ne savent même pas parler.

sw.L: Sanamu ya kuchonga inafaa nini, hata mtengenezaji wake aichonge, \q sanamu ya kusubu na mwalimu wa uongo? \q Kwa maana aliyeiumba anatumainia kazi yake mwenyewe \q anapotengeneza sanamu bubu.
sw.B: Sanamu ina faida gani mara fundi wake akiisha kuichonga, \q au sanamu ya chuma, mwalimu wa uongo? \q Mtengenezaji wake anatumainia kile alichokiunda mwenyewe \q anapotengeneza sanamu zisizoweza kusema.
sw.R: Sanamu aliyoichonga mtu ina faida gani, \q au sanamu ya chuma? Inafundisha uongo tu. \q Watu wanaotengeneza sanamu wanatumainia kile walichokitengeneza, \q lakini sanamu zao haziwezi hata kuongea.

vi.L: Tượng chạm có ích gì mà người thợ đã chạm nó, \q tượng đúc và [là] thầy dạy sự dối trá? \q Vì người nặn nó tin cậy vào chính tác phẩm mình \q khi làm ra những thần tượng câm.
vi.B: Thần tượng có ích gì khi người thợ đã tạc nó, \q hay một tượng kim loại, một thầy dạy điều dối trá? \q Kẻ làm ra nó tin cậy vào vật chính tay mình nắn nên \q khi làm ra những thần tượng không biết nói.
vi.R: Thần tượng do người ta chạm khắc có ích gì, \q hay một tượng kim loại? Nó chỉ dạy điều dối trá. \q Những người làm thần tượng tin cậy vào vật họ làm ra, \q nhưng thần tượng của họ còn không biết nói.

ko.L: 새긴 우상이, 그것을 만든 자가 그것을 새겼으니, 무슨 유익이 있느냐? \q 부어 만든 우상과 거짓을 가르치는 것이 [무슨 유익이 있느냐]? \q 그것을 빚은 자가 자기가 만든 것을 의지하여 \q 말 못하는 우상들을 만들기 때문이다.
ko.B: 장인이 새겨 만든 우상이 무슨 소용이 있느냐? \q 쇠붙이 우상, 거짓을 가르치는 것이 무슨 소용이 있느냐? \q 그것을 만든 자가 자기 손으로 빚은 것을 의지하여 \q 말도 못하는 우상들을 만들어 낸다.
ko.R: 사람이 깎아 만든 우상이 무슨 쓸모가 있느냐? \q 쇠로 만든 우상은 어떠하냐? 그것은 거짓만 가르친다. \q 우상을 만드는 사람들은 자기가 만든 것을 의지하지만, \q 그 우상들은 말조차 하지 못한다.

decisions.choice: What does a carved image profit?: the folly of idols
decisions.reason: The prophets mock idols as things made by human hands that cannot save (Isaiah 44:9-20; Jeremiah 10:1-16; Psalm 115:4-8). The Babylonian who makes his strength his god (1:11, 16) trusts in what he himself has made.

decisions.choice: a teacher of lies ... mute idols
decisions.reason: Idols were consulted for guidance through their priests, so they are "teachers", but they teach only falsehood. The Hebrew words for "idols" and "mute" sound alike; the first means "worthless things" or "nothings" (Isaiah 2:8).

decisions.choice: People who make idols ... they (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew singular, the craftsman who carves the idol. Readable uses the plural, since he stands for anyone who makes idols, so that no gender span is needed.

source.text: ה֣וֹי אֹמֵ֤ר לָעֵץ֙ הָקִ֔יצָה ע֖וּרִי לְאֶ֣בֶן דּוּמָ֑ם ה֣וּא יוֹרֶ֔ה הִנֵּה־ה֗וּא תָּפוּשׂ֙ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֔סֶף וְכָל־ר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to one who] says to wood, Wake up! Awake! to stone of silence. Will it teach? Look, it [is] overlaid [with] gold and silver, and any breath there is not within it.

en.L: Woe, [the one who] says to wood, "Wake up!" \q "Awake!" to silent stone. \q Will it teach? \q Look, it [is] encased in gold and silver, \q and there is no breath at all inside it.
en.B: Woe to him who says to a piece of wood, "Wake up!" \q or to a lifeless stone, "Get up!" \q Can it teach? \q It is covered with gold and silver, \q but there is no breath in it at all.
en.R: How terrible it will be for anyone who says to a piece of wood, "Wake up!" \q or says to a stone that cannot speak, "Get up!" \q Can an idol teach anyone anything? \q It may be covered with gold and silver, \q but it has no life in it at all.

es.L: ¡Ay del que dice al madero: «¡Despierta!», \q «¡Levántate!», a la piedra muda! \q ¿Enseñará ella? \q He aquí, [está] recubierta de oro y plata, \q y no hay ningún aliento dentro de ella.
es.B: ¡Ay del que dice a un trozo de madera: «¡Despierta!», \q o a una piedra sin vida: «¡Levántate!»! \q ¿Puede enseñar? \q Está cubierta de oro y plata, \q pero no hay en ella aliento alguno.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para el que le dice a un trozo de madera: «¡Despierta!», \q o le dice a una piedra que no puede hablar: «¡Levántate!»! \q ¿Puede un ídolo enseñarle algo a alguien? \q Puede estar cubierto de oro y plata, \q pero no tiene nada de vida.

fr.L: Malheur, [celui qui] dit au bois : « Réveille-toi ! » \q « Éveille-toi ! » à la pierre muette. \q Elle, enseigner ? \q Voici, elle [est] plaquée d’or et d’argent, \q et il n’y a aucun souffle au-dedans d’elle.
fr.B: Malheur à celui qui dit à un morceau de bois : « Réveille-toi ! » \q ou à une pierre sans vie : « Lève-toi ! » \q Peut-elle enseigner ? \q Elle est recouverte d’or et d’argent, \q mais il n’y a en elle aucun souffle.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour celui qui dit à un morceau de bois : « Réveille-toi ! » \q ou à une pierre qui ne peut pas parler : « Lève-toi ! » \q Une idole peut-elle enseigner quoi que ce soit ? \q Elle est peut-être couverte d’or et d’argent, \q mais il n’y a aucune vie en elle.

sw.L: Ole, [yeye] akiambiaye kipande cha mti, "Amka!" \q "Inuka!" kwa jiwe lisilonena. \q Je, kitafundisha? \q Tazama, kimefunikwa kwa dhahabu na fedha, \q wala hamna pumzi yoyote ndani yake.
sw.B: Ole wake akiambiaye kipande cha mti, "Amka!" \q au jiwe lisilo na uhai, "Inuka!" \q Je, kinaweza kufundisha? \q Kimefunikwa kwa dhahabu na fedha, \q lakini hakuna pumzi ndani yake hata kidogo.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa yeyote anayekiambia kipande cha mti, "Amka!" \q au kuliambia jiwe lisiloweza kusema, "Inuka!" \q Je, sanamu inaweza kumfundisha mtu yeyote kitu chochote? \q Inaweza kuwa imefunikwa kwa dhahabu na fedha, \q lakini haina uhai hata kidogo.

vi.L: Khốn cho [kẻ] nói với khúc gỗ: "Hãy thức dậy!" \q "Hãy trỗi dậy!" với hòn đá câm lặng. \q Nó sẽ dạy dỗ sao? \q Này, nó được bọc vàng và bạc, \q và chẳng có chút hơi thở nào trong nó.
vi.B: Khốn cho kẻ nói với khúc gỗ: "Hãy thức dậy!" \q hay với hòn đá vô tri: "Hãy đứng dậy!" \q Nó có thể dạy dỗ được sao? \q Nó được bọc vàng và bạc, \q nhưng chẳng có chút hơi thở nào trong nó.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho kẻ nói với khúc gỗ: "Hãy thức dậy!" \q hay nói với hòn đá không biết nói: "Hãy đứng dậy!" \q Thần tượng có thể dạy ai điều gì sao? \q Nó có thể được bọc vàng và bạc, \q nhưng chẳng có chút sự sống nào trong nó.

ko.L: 나무에게 "깨어라!" \q 말 못하는 돌에게 "일어나라!" 하고 말하는 자에게 화가 있다! \q 그것이 가르치겠느냐? \q 보라, 그것은 금과 은으로 입혀졌으나, \q 그 안에는 숨이 전혀 없다.
ko.B: 나무토막에게 "깨어라!" 하고 \q 생명 없는 돌에게 "일어나라!" 하고 말하는 자에게 화가 있다! \q 그것이 가르칠 수 있느냐? \q 그것은 금과 은으로 입혀졌지만, \q 그 안에는 숨이 조금도 없다.
ko.R: 나무토막에게 "깨어나라!" 하고 \q 말 못하는 돌에게 "일어나라!" 하고 말하는 자에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! \q 우상이 누구에게 무엇을 가르칠 수 있겠느냐? \q 그것이 금과 은으로 덮여 있을지라도 \q 그 안에는 생명이 조금도 없다.

decisions.choice: Wake up! to wood and stone: calling on idols
decisions.reason: Worshipers called on their gods to wake and act, as the prophets of Baal did when Elijah mocked them (1 Kings 18:27). Psalm 44:24 calls on the LORD to "wake up", but the LORD hears; the wood and stone cannot.

decisions.choice: no breath at all within it
decisions.reason: "Breath" is the breath of life (Genesis 2:7). However richly it is plated, the idol is dead (Jeremiah 10:14). The next verse sets the living LORD against it.

decisions.choice: Woe (L); Woe to (B); How terrible it will be for (R)
decisions.reason: The fifth woe follows the wording of verse 6. Readable says "anyone", since the saying applies to every idol worshiper.

records.literal_gloss: But Yahweh [is] in [the] temple of his holiness; hush before him, all the earth!

en.L: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple; \q hush before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the earth!
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple; \q all the earth, be hushed before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple. \q Everyone on earth should be silent in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.

es.L: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo templo; \q ¡silencio ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, toda la tierra!
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo templo; \q ¡toda la tierra, haga silencio ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo templo. \q Todos en la tierra deben callar en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.

fr.L: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint temple ; \q silence devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toute la terre !
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint temple ; \q que toute la terre fasse silence devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple saint. \q Que tous les habitants de la terre se taisent devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yuko] katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; \q kimya mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia yote!
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; \q dunia yote, nyamazeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu. \q Kila mtu duniani anapaswa kunyamaza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] trong đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q im lặng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi khắp đất!
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trong đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hỡi khắp đất, hãy lặng im trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trong đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Mọi người trên đất hãy yên lặng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 거룩한 성전에 [계신다]. \q 온 땅아, 그분 앞에서 입을 다물어라!
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 거룩한 성전에 계신다. \q 온 땅은 그분 앞에서 숨을 죽여라.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 거룩한 성전에 계신다. \q 세상 모든 사람은 그분 앞에서 조용히 해야 한다.

decisions.choice: the LORD is in his holy temple: the words of Psalm 11:4
decisions.reason: Psalm 11:4 begins: "The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD's throne is in heaven." The temple may be the temple in Jerusalem or his dwelling in heaven; the point is that the living God reigns, unlike the lifeless idols of verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: hush before him, all the earth!: silent awe before God who is about to act
decisions.reason: The word is a call for silence, like "Hush!" (Amos 6:10). It is used before the LORD comes to judge (Zephaniah 1:7; Zechariah 2:17). The whole earth, the nations that Babylon ruled and Babylon itself, must fall silent before him. The prayer of chapter 3 follows.

decisions.choice: the Psalm 11:4 wording; hush (L, B); be silent (R)
decisions.reason: "The LORD [is] in his holy temple" follows Psalm 11:4 at each level. Literal and Balanced keep the word "hush"; Readable says "be silent".

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR [está] en su santo templo" (L), "… está en su santo templo" (B, R), the published Psalm 11:4; "¡silencio ante él!" (L)
decisions.reason: The first line is the wording of Psalm 11:4 (m1); the call to silence is drafted from the Hebrew interjection *has* (m2).

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR [est] dans son saint temple" (L), "… est dans son saint temple" (B), "… dans son temple saint" (R), the published Psalm 11:4
decisions.reason: The line is Psalm 11:4; French reuses the published Psalm at each level.

decisions.choice: "BWANA [yuko] katika hekalu lake takatifu" as the published Psalm 11:4; "kimya" (L) for the interjection *has*, "nyamazeni" (B), "kunyamaza" (R)
decisions.reason: The first line follows Psalm 11:4 (m1); Literal keeps the bare call "Hush!" (m2).

decisions.choice: "CHÚA [ở] trong đền thánh của Ngài" as the published Psalm 11:4; "im lặng" / "lặng im" / "yên lặng" for *has*
decisions.reason: The first line follows Psalm 11:4 (m1); the call to silence is drafted fresh from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 거룩한 성전에 계신다" as Psalm 11:4; "입을 다물어라" (L), "숨을 죽여라" (B), "조용히 해야 한다" (R) for *has*
decisions.reason: The first line follows Psalm 11:4 (m1); the call to silence is drafted from the Hebrew interjection, away from the familiar wording.
